question: What was the median cycle time by region for claims reported in April to July 2026?

sql:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
           c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT region, median(days_to_close) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed') AS value
FROM source
WHERE report_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
  AND report_date <= DATE '2026-07-31'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL

report.interpretation: Median cycle time (days from report date to close date) for closed claims, by region, for claims with a report date from 2026-04-01 to 2026-07-31. This uses the agreed cycle_time_days metric. It covers all products (motor and home), and open claims are excluded.
report.answer: Median cycle times were NSW & ACT 26 days, QLD & NT 27 days, West & South 28.5 days and VIC & TAS 29 days. The regions are close together, within about 3 days. Only closed claims count (1,595 of 1,625). VIC & TAS has the most still open (19 of 393), so its figure may rise slightly as those close. The April to July cohorts are also somewhat flattered, because their slowest claims are still open.
report.answer_sql: SELECT region, median(close_date - report_date) AS median_cycle_days FROM claims WHERE status='closed' AND report_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
